target.class_name: Anh văn chuyên ngành Cơ khí
target.lesson_title: Chapter 9: CAD/CAM — Thiết kế và gia công có máy tính

exam.title: Kiểm tra từ vựng Chapter 9: CAD/CAM

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
The process of making products, often in a factory.
questions.explanation: manufacturing = sản xuất, chế tạo.

questions.question: Which English word means “chi phí nhân công”?
questions.explanation: labour cost: The money paid to workers for their work.

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
A picture that shows the shape and size of a part.
questions.explanation: drawing = bản vẽ.

questions.question: What does finished part mean?
questions.explanation: finished part = chi tiết hoàn thiện.

questions.question: Which English word means “máy công cụ”?
questions.explanation: machine tool: A power-driven machine that cuts or shapes metal.

questions.question: Which English word means “thất nghiệp”?
questions.explanation: unemployment: The situation of having no job when you want to work.

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
A harmful program that damages files on a computer.
questions.explanation: virus = vi-rút máy tính.

questions.question: Which English word means “thiết kế”?
questions.explanation: design: To plan how a product will look and work.

questions.question: What does advantage mean?
questions.explanation: advantage = ưu điểm.

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
A way of controlling a machine tool with a computer program.
questions.explanation: CNC = điều khiển số bằng máy tính.

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
The first test version of a product, made before mass production.
questions.explanation: prototype = mẫu thử.

questions.question: What does assemble mean?
questions.explanation: assemble = lắp ráp.

questions.question: Which English word means “mô phỏng”?
questions.explanation: simulation: A computer test that shows how a design will behave.

questions.question: Which English word means “mô hình 3D”?
questions.explanation: 3D model: A computer shape that shows a part with length, width and height.

questions.question: What does realistic mean?
questions.explanation: realistic = giống thật, sát thực tế.

questions.question: Which English word means “đáng tin cậy, ổn định”?
questions.explanation: reliable: Able to be trusted to work well every time.

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
The use of computers to create and change designs.
questions.explanation: CAD = thiết kế có sự hỗ trợ của máy tính.

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
A mistake made by a person, not by a machine.
questions.explanation: human error = lỗi do con người.

questions.question: Which English word means “gia công có sự hỗ trợ của máy tính”?
questions.explanation: CAM: The use of computer software to control machine tools that make products.

questions.question: What does modify mean?
questions.explanation: modify = sửa đổi, chỉnh lại.

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
The shape and size of a part, shown by lines, surfaces and solids.
questions.explanation: geometry = hình dạng và kích thước của chi tiết.

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
The use of machines to do work without human help.
questions.explanation: automation = tự động hoá.

questions.question: Which English word means “sản xuất hàng loạt”?
questions.explanation: mass production: Making large numbers of the same product, usually by machines.

questions.question: Which English word means “phần mềm”?
questions.explanation: software: Programs that tell a computer what to do.

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
A skilled worker who sets up and runs machine tools.
questions.explanation: machinist = thợ gia công, thợ máy.
